goal_summary: Marketing website for Acme Consulting (B2B ops advisory) to explain services, show case studies, and capture leads via contact form and Calendly.
problem_statement: Current WordPress template is slow (Lighthouse 52), has no clear CTA, and case studies are PDFs. Need fast static site we can update without developer.
success_criteria: Contact form delivers to jane@acme.co and shows confirmation
Case study pages editable via Markdown by non-dev
features_in: 5-page responsive site: Home, Services, Case Studies, About, Contact
Basic SEO: sitemap, meta tags, OG images
features_out: No custom CRM — email delivery only
